answers.description: HR consultancy for growing firms with 10 to 80 staff. Contracts, handbooks, difficult conversations and TUPE, on a retainer or by the day. Based in Manchester and working across the north west.

hero.subhead: Contracts, handbooks and tricky conversations handled, for growing firms across the north west.

paragraphs: We set up Northgate People to give growing firms proper HR support without the fuss.
We work with firms of 10 to 80 staff across Manchester and the north west.

services.lead: Practical HR help across the north west, built around your firm.

items.title: Contracts and handbooks
items.body: Clear contracts and handbooks that fit your firm, so your team knows where it stands from day one.

items.title: Difficult conversations
items.body: Support when conversations get hard, so you handle them fairly and with confidence.

items.title: TUPE guidance
items.body: Guidance through TUPE, so transfers and changes are managed properly and without panic.

faq.question: What size of firm do you work with?
faq.answer: We work with growing firms with 10 to 80 staff, across Manchester and the north west.

faq.question: How does support work?
faq.answer: We talk through your situation and work out whether a retainer or day rate suits you.

faq.question: Can you help with TUPE?
faq.answer: Yes, we guide you through TUPE so transfers and changes are managed properly and without panic.

faq.question: Do you help with difficult conversations?
faq.answer: Yes, we support you when conversations get hard, so you handle them fairly and with confidence.

faq.question: What happens after I get in touch?
faq.answer: Tell us about your firm and what you need help with, and we will take it from there.

form.lead: Tell us about your firm and what you need help with.
form.placeholder: What do you need help with?

cta.body: We set up Northgate People to give growing firms proper HR support without the fuss. Get in touch to find out more.
